title: Closeout summary: Cross-project graph edge endpoints
body:
## Agent Finish Summary

pnpm check passed. Implemented cross-project graph-edge endpoint qualifiers: GraphEdge now accepts optional fromProjectId/toProjectId, graph-engine identity/traversal/cycle detection uses qualified endpoint keys with local-project shorthand, schema validation covers the new fields, and runtime tests cover schema, cycle detection, and file-store round-trip behavior.

Close reason: Cross-project graph edge endpoint support is implemented, validated, and checkpointed.
